train_mtm_model: train a MTM model on a dataset using Hydra config with distributed training support
eval_forward_dynamics: evaluate the MTM model on forward dynamics task by predicting next states from actions
eval_inverse_dynamics: evaluate the MTM model on inverse dynamics task by predicting actions from states
create_eval_visualizations: create evaluation logs with visualization plots for states actions and images using mask patterns
configure_training_run: configure and launch a MTM training job with Hydra config including wandb logging and checkpointing
